name: Data Structures for Applied Mathematics
description: Introduction to some basic concepts of Object Oriented Programming and Review of some basic concepts of Python-programming language such as Class, Objects and some Built in Classes, Lists, Arrays; Growth rate of Functions: Big Oh, small oh, Big Omega, small omega and theta notations; Data structures: Arrays, Linked List, stacks, queues, Binary Search trees, Balanced Binary Trees: AVL trees; Binary Heaps; and their use in implementing some basic Algorithms; Data structures for representing graphs: Adjacency matrix and Adjacency lists; Sorting: Insertion Sort, Bubble Sort, Selection Sort, merge sort, quick sort, radix sort, and bucket sort; lower Bound for Sorting; Binary Search; Graph Algorithms: Breadth first search, Depth first search; Dijkstra’s shortest path algorithm, Prim’s and Kruskal’s MST algorithms; Hash Table Structure, Hash Functions, Linear Open Addressing, Chaining
